contract.description: The undo door for a memory whose earlier correction turned out wrong: the record returns to active and the correction that buried it is tombstoned on the correction trail, leaving one active truth per fact. Unknown or foreign-tome ids come back restored=false; repeating a restore is safe - it converges a half-applied reversal and is otherwise a no-op.
contract.name: memory_restore
contract.title: Restore a memory
